_comment: Warm light source -- the umbrella archetype for Limbo's campfires, braziers, and oil lamps. Same warm-amber color + fire flicker; per-instance intensity/range overrides differentiate main encampment lights (1.0 / 16m) from smaller companion lights (0.3 / 5m) without proliferating archetype files. Defaults match the legacy registerLimboLights makeLight call for a typical 'campfire_a' main light.
